title: Cersaie 2025 Wrap-up
bodyHtml:
Where Global Bathroom Design Converges

Every September, Cersaie transforms Bologna into the world’s centre for ceramic and bathroom innovation.

Our team was on the ground again this year to explore what’s next — gathering insights from Europe’s leading manufacturers to share with the Australian design community.

A Turning Point for Vortex Flush

The shift to Vortex flush technology is now undeniable, with virtually every major manufacturer presenting their own interpretation of this innovation.

We’re proud to be at the vanguard of this evolution locally, introducing two outstanding Vortex designs - Monolith by Olympia Ceramica and Futura by Hatria Ceramica.

Both combine minimalist aesthetics with exceptional flushing performance — reflecting the new benchmark in contemporary bathroom design.


Monolith Vortex Flush Wall Faced Pan - by Olympia Ceramica

The Enduring Appeal of Gloss Colour

Gloss-colour ceramic remains a defining element of design-conscious bathrooms. This year, we saw the palette expand further across other elements of the bathroom, with manufacturers producing matching furniture, mirrors and even flush plates, allowing colour to tie together the entire bathroom composition.

Studio Bagno continues to champion gloss colour as a way to create focal points that feel both expressive and elevated.


Vita 40 by Azzurra Ceramica

Softer, Bolder Forms

Designers are moving away from the ultra-thin, sharp-edged aesthetics of recent years toward thicker, rounded profiles with softened edges.

This shift feels refreshingly new yet elegantly timeless, bringing warmth and tactility back to the bathroom space.


Idilla Square & Structure by Alice Ceramica

Matte White - Quietly Dominant

The popularity of matte white ceramic has only strengthened. Manufacturers reported significant growth in matte white sales versus last year — proof of its increasing appeal.

Its soft, tactile finish and effortless compatibility with diverse material palettes make it a premium choice we believe will remain relevant for years to come.


Milady Wall Hung Pan in Matte White

Porcelain Tiles with New Depth

Tile producers such as Atlas Concorde are redefining realism in natural stone and timber-look surfaces.

By applying a controlled acid-erosion technique, they’ve introduced subtle 3D effects that enhance texture and depth — a noteworthy advancement in surface design.
